book.name: Aisaiya
book.title: Aisaiya Aisaiya Bin Gibit Wed Brom God

content: “Ol yumob pipul, yumob garra abum bigbala trabul na! Yumob oldei dumbat krulbala ting en meigimbat nogudwan lowa,
weya trikimbat ola po pipul hu nomo garram enijing, en yumob oldei stilimbat enijing brom ola widogel en ola biginini hu nomo garram mami en dedi.
Bat wanim yumob garra dum wen ola pipul brom najawan kantri garra kilim yumob en panishim yumob? Langa hu yumob garra go blanga albumbat yumob? Weya yumob garra haidim ola gudbala ting blanga yumob?
Oni wan ting blanga yumob. Yumob garra jidan prisana o yumob garra dai. Wal YAWEI im stil wail langa yumob en im garra kipgon panishimbat yumob.” Lagijat na aibin tok.
YAWEI bin meigim plen blanga det king brom Asiriya
Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok na, “Mi stil wail langa yumob, en ai garra yusum det king blanga Asiriya. Im garra jidan wulijim bigwan wadi blanga yumob,

blanga kilim ol yumob pipul hu nomo bilib langa mi. Mi brabli wail langa yumob, en ai garra jandim im blanga fait langa yumob. Im garra gajim ola ebrijing im wandim, en im garra wokwokbat brabli adbalawei ontop langa yumob, jis laik wen im wokwokbat langa det mad langa det strit.
Det king brom Asiriya im garram im ronwan plen langa im hed, dumaji im wandim binijimap ola kantri.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
Wal det King brom Asiriya bin tok na, “Blanga ol main boswan ami men, olabat jidan jis laiga king.
Deibin olredi teikoba ol detlot pipul brom detlot taun gulum Kelno, Kakamish, Heimath, Apad, Sameriya en Dameskas.

En detlot drimin blanga Jerusalem en Sameriya olabat brabli wikwan, bat detlot drimin blanga detlot najalot kantri, olabat mowa strongbala. En ai garra binijimap Jerusalem en detlot drimin blanga olabat, en ola drimin sheip du, jis laik wen aibin dum langa Sameriya.” Lagijat na det king bin tok.

Aibin tok na, “Wal YAWEI garra dum ebrijing im wandim langa Jerusalem en langa det bigwan hil gulum Saiyan. En afta tharran, im garra panishim det king brom Asiriya hu oldei laigim miselp en oldei toktokbat praudbalawei.

Im tok, ‘Aibin dum ol dislot ting garram main ronwan pawa, dumaji mi brabli klebawan. Aibin kilim ola king jis laik deibin wailwan buligi, en aibin teikoba olabat kantri, en aibin gajim ola gudwan ebrijing brom olabat kantri.
Aibin gajim ebrijing brom detlot kantri. Imbin mowa isiwan blanga go en gajim detlot eig brom det nes wen det bard nomo bin jidan deya.’
“Yu king brom Asiriya yu lisin langa mi na. Yu reken det eks o sowa im mowa strongbala langa det men hu oldei yusumbat im? Yu reken det wadi gin lidimap det men hu holdimbat langa im?
YAWEI det boswan God garra jandim brabli nogudbala siknis blanga binijimap ol yu ami olabat, en det praudbalawei blanga yu garra barnbarn laiga bigis faiya.
Det brabli holiwan God, im na det lait blanga ola Isreil pipul. Im garra jidan wulijim det faiya, en ebrijing blanga yu garra barnbarn langa det faiya na, jis laik draiwan gras.
YAWEI garra binijimap ol detlot brabli gudbala bush kantri blanga yumob, en ol detlot gudwan fam, jis laik wen sambodi dai brom siknis.
En oni lilbit tri garra jidan deya, weya im isi blanga lilwan biginini blanga kaundimap olabat.”
Oni lilbit pipul garra kambek

Wal aibin kipgon tok, “Bambai na, det taim garra kaman wen detlot pipul brom Isreil en Juda hu stil jidan laibala garra trastimbat langa det brabli holiwan God blanga ola Isreil pipul. Olabat kaan kipgon trastim det king hubin oldei bidimbat langa olabat.

Bigismob Isreil pipul bin jidan, jis laik det sengraun weya jidan langa solwodasaid, bat oni lilbit pipul garra jidan laibala blanga kambek langa olabat brabli strongbala God. God bin dum raitwan ting wen imbin panishimbat im pipul olabat.
YAWEI det brabli boswan God bin meigim pramis blanga panishim ebribodi langa dijan wel.

“Wal YAWEI det brabli boswan God bin tok langa im pipul langa Jerusalem na, ‘Yumob nomo bradin blanga detlot Asiriya pipul, nomeda dei garra beldim yumob garram wadi, wulijim detlot Ijip pipul bin dum basdam.
Bambai na ai kaan wail langa yumob enimo. Ai garra panishim detlot pipul hubin deigimoba langa yumob.

Mi na YAWEI det boswan God garra beldim detlot Asiriya pipul garram wip, jis laik wen aibin dum langa detlot Midiyan pipul gulijap langa det Oreb Ston. En ai garra shoum yumob det seimwan strongbala pawa weya aibin yusumbat wen aibin meigim det roud blanga yumob blanga krosim langa det solwoda langa Ijip.
Langa det dei na, olabat kaan jidan bos blanga yumob kantri. Ebrijing garra jidan gudwei blanga yumob, en ol detlot adtaim weya yumob bin oldei abumbat garra binij.’
“Wal detlot enami bin kaman brom Riman langa det taun gulum Ai. Olabat bin go thru langa det taun gulum Migron, en olabat bin pudum olabat ebrijing langa det taun gulum Mikmesh,

bifo olabat bin go najasaid langa det hil kantri weya olabat bin silip langa det pleis gulum Geba. Ol detlot pipul hubin oldei jidan langa det taun gulum Rema bin brabli bradin, en ola pipul langa det taun weya Sol bin bon gulum Gibiya, bin ol ranawei.
Yumob gin irrim ebribodi kraikraibat langa detlot taun gulum Gelim, Layisha, en det sedwan taun gulum Einathoth.
En nomo enibodi bin jidan langa det dubala taun gulum Medmena en Gebim, dumaji deibin ol bradin en bin ranawei.
Wal tudei na detlot enami garram kemp langa det taun gulum Nob, en deya na olabat sheikimbat olabat bingga brabli wailwei langa det hil gulum Saiyan langa Jerusalem.
“YAWEI det boswan God garra yusum im brabli strongbala pawa blanga binijimap det king brom Asiriya en im soljamob jis laik im kadimdan ola longwan tri, en kadimdan ola bushis blanga detlot tri.
YAWEI garra kadimdan detlot enami jis laik im kadimdan ola tri garram eks langa det hil kantri blanga Lebanan.”
